# Actions reference

Every admin operation is an action. The admin app, the CLI (`beamhop <group> <name>`), the admin API (`POST /api/v1/nodes/self[/relays/<relay>]/actions/<id>`, see `/api/v1/openapi.json`), the command palette and NIP-86 all run these same actions. Changes show a preview first and can be undone where marked.

## access

### Add members

Let these people post (and read, if sign-in is required).

- **id:** `access.add-allowlist` · **CLI:** `beamhop access add-allowlist` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `users.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable · bulk
- *Technical:* Adds pubkeys to policy.allowlist (used in allowlist and WoT modes).

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pubkeys` | list of string |  |  |
| `note` | string |  |  |

### Create invite

A code people can use to join as members.

- **id:** `access.create-invite` · **CLI:** `beamhop access create-invite` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `users.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Creates policy.invites entry; redeeming adds the pubkey to policy.allowlist.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expiresInHours` | number | `168` |  |
| `maxUses` | number | `1` |  |
| `note` | string |  |  |

### Allowed accounts

Accounts that may post here when the relay is invite-only.

- **id:** `access.list-allowed-pubkeys` · **CLI:** `beamhop access list-allowed-pubkeys` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* policy.allowlist for this relay (NIP-86 listallowedpubkeys).

### Invite codes

Invite codes for this relay, with how often each was used.

- **id:** `access.list-invites` · **CLI:** `beamhop access list-invites` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `users.write`
- read-only
- *Technical:* policy.invites for this relay; codes are secrets, so this needs users.write.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `includeExpired` | boolean | `false` | Also show expired or used-up codes |

### Remove members

These people can no longer post (unless the relay is open).

- **id:** `access.remove-allowlist` · **CLI:** `beamhop access remove-allowlist` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `users.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable · bulk
- *Technical:* Removes pubkeys from policy.allowlist.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pubkeys` | list of string |  |  |

## admins

### Invite an admin

Give someone access to manage this relay, with a role that limits what they can do.

- **id:** `admins.invite` · **CLI:** `beamhop admins invite` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `admins.manage`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Adds an admin principal (by Nostr pubkey) or creates a one-time invite code (7 days) redeemable via NIP-98 or passkey login.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pubkey` | string |  | Their Nostr public key (npub…). Leave empty to get an invite code. |
| `role` | `owner` \| `admin` \| `moderator` \| `viewer` |  | What they may do |
| `relayId` | string |  | Limit access to one relay (empty = all relays) |
| `displayName` | string |  | Name shown to the team |

### Show the team

Everyone who can manage this relay and their roles.

- **id:** `admins.list` · **CLI:** `beamhop admins list` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only

### Create new owner recovery codes

Get a fresh set of one-time codes that let an owner back in if they lose their key. Old codes stop working.

- **id:** `admins.recovery-codes` · **CLI:** `beamhop admins recovery-codes` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `admins.manage`
- changes settings/data · needs a second approver when approvals are on
- *Technical:* Replaces the hashed recovery code set; a code redeemed at login grants the owner role to that principal.

### Check how you would get back in

Shows whether this relay can be recovered if an owner loses their key: recovery codes, a second owner and passkeys.

- **id:** `admins.recovery-status` · **CLI:** `beamhop admins recovery-status` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* Counts remaining hashed recovery codes, principals with roles["*"] = owner, and WebAuthn credentials bound to the caller.

### Remove an admin

Take away all of someone’s admin access. Their API tokens stop working too.

- **id:** `admins.remove` · **CLI:** `beamhop admins remove` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `admins.manage`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Deletes the admin principal; sessions, tokens and passkeys bound to it no longer authenticate.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | The team member |

### Change an admin’s role

Change what a team member may do, for all relays or for one relay.

- **id:** `admins.set-role` · **CLI:** `beamhop admins set-role` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `admins.manage`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Sets principal.roles[relayId\|*]; role "none" removes that scope.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | The team member |
| `role` | `owner` \| `admin` \| `moderator` \| `viewer` \| `none` |  | New role ("none" removes access for that scope) |
| `relayId` | string |  | Only for this relay (empty = all relays) |

## ai

### Write a plugin with AI

Describe a rule in your own words. The assistant writes a plugin and tests, checks them, and installs it turned off so you can review it first.

- **id:** `ai.generate-plugin` · **CLI:** `beamhop ai generate-plugin` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `plugins.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable · needs a second approver when approvals are on
- *Technical:* LLM → plugin.ts (definePlugin, @beamhop/plugins/sdk) + plugin.test.ts (testbed); static import allow-list; tests run in the plugin host sandbox; installed with enabled=false.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `description` | string |  | What the plugin should do, in your own words |
| `id` | string |  | Short id (letters, digits, dashes); made up from the description when empty |

- **id:** `ai.moderation-labels` · **CLI:** `beamhop ai moderation-labels` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* DocStore ai.labels keyed `${relayId}:${queueItemId}`; produced by the ai.label-queue job.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ids` | list of string |  |  |

## approvals

### Approve a request

Let another admin go ahead with a risky change. You cannot approve your own.

- **id:** `approvals.approve` · **CLI:** `beamhop approvals approve` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- changes settings/data
- *Technical:* Two-person rule: approver ≠ requester, approver needs the gated action’s permission; single-use, expires.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | string |  | Approval request id |
| `note` | string |  | Optional note for the requester |

### Deny a request

Stop a risky change another admin asked for (or withdraw your own).

- **id:** `approvals.deny` · **CLI:** `beamhop approvals deny` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- changes settings/data
- *Technical:* Marks the request denied; it can no longer be used.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `requestId` | string |  | Approval request id |
| `note` | string |  | Optional note for the requester |

### Show approval requests

Risky changes waiting for (or decided by) a second admin.

- **id:** `approvals.list` · **CLI:** `beamhop approvals list` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* Two-person rule (§12.9); requests live in compliance.approvals.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | `pending` \| `approved` \| `denied` \| `expired` \| `used` |  |  |
| `limit` | number | `100` |  |

### Restore a backup

Put everything back the way it was when the backup was made.

- **id:** `backups.restore` · **CLI:** `beamhop backups restore` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `node.manage`
- changes settings/data · needs a second approver when approvals are on
- *Technical:* Verify hashes → pause writes (policy hook) → replace tables (tags/FTS rebuilt by triggers) → verify row counts → copy missing blob bytes from the target.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

### Back up now

Make a backup of posts, media lists and settings right away.

- **id:** `backups.run-now` · **CLI:** `beamhop backups run-now` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `node.manage`
- changes settings/data
- *Technical:* SQLite VACUUM INTO / logical NDJSON table dump + blob manifest + config revision → tar.gz in the backup target.

### Set up backups

Choose how often to back up, how many backups to keep and where they go.

- **id:** `backups.setup` · **CLI:** `beamhop backups setup` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `node.manage`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Patches config.backups via admin.config (revisioned, undoable).

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | boolean | `true` |  |
| `schedule` | `hourly` \| `daily` \| `weekly` | `"daily"` |  |
| `keep` | number | `14` |  |
| `target` | section |  | A place to keep files: this server or a cloud storage service |
| `target.driver` | `fs` \| `s3` \| `r2` \| `gcs` \| `memory` | `"fs"` | Which storage service to use. Pick cloud storage when this server's disk is too small or you want copies kept elsewhere. |
| `target.path` | string |  | Folder on this server where the files go. Empty = a folder inside the data folder. |
| `target.bucket` | string |  | Name of the storage bucket you created with your provider. |
| `target.endpoint` | string |  | Your provider's storage address. Leave empty for Amazon S3 and Google Cloud; needed for R2, MinIO and others. *Technical:* S3 API endpoint (path-style). Defaults: https://s3.<region>.amazonaws.com, https://storage.googleapis.com. |
| `target.region` | string |  | Data-center region of the bucket. Empty = us-east-1 for S3, auto otherwise. *Technical:* SigV4 signing region. |
| `target.accessKeyId` | string |  | The access key ID from your storage provider. |
| `target.secretAccessKey` | string |  | The secret that goes with the access key. Stored privately, never shown again. |

## compliance

### Check where data is stored

Make sure each relay’s data stays in its required region.

- **id:** `compliance.check-residency` · **CLI:** `beamhop compliance check-residency` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `compliance.read`
- read-only

### Start a legal hold

Freeze data so nobody can delete it — not the people themselves, retention or admins — until the hold is released.

- **id:** `compliance.create-hold` · **CLI:** `beamhop compliance create-hold` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `compliance.write`
- changes settings/data
- *Technical:* Blocks retention / NIP-62 vanish / crypto-shred / recycle purge via lifecycle.holds; NIP-09 & admin deletions are archived to compliance.hold-archive first; blobs are pinned.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | Matter name |
| `reason` | string |  | Why the data must be kept |
| `pubkeys` | list of string | `[]` | People (public keys, hex) |
| `subjects` | list | `[]` | People from the company directory |
| `subjects[].subject` | string |  |  |
| `subjects[].idp` | string |  |  |
| `groups` | list of string | `[]` | Company directory groups |
| `relays` | list of string | `[]` | Relays (all when empty) |
| `since` | number |  | From (unix time) |
| `until` | number |  | Until (unix time) |
| `kinds` | list of number |  |  |

- changes settings/data
- *Technical:* NDJSON events per relay + blobs.ndjson manifest + manifest.json (sha256 of every file) + signature.json (BIP-340 by the node key); stored content-addressed in the blob store and pinned.

| `subjects` | list | `[]` | People from the company directory |
| `subjects[].subject` | string |  |  |
| `subjects[].idp` | string |  |  |
| `groups` | list of string | `[]` | Company directory groups |
| `relays` | list of string | `[]` | Relays (all when empty) |
| `since` | number |  | From (unix time) |
| `until` | number |  | Until (unix time) |
| `kinds` | list of number |  |  |
| `keywords` | list of string | `[]` | Only posts containing these words |
| `includeBlobs` | boolean |  | Include the list of files |

## config

### Change relay type

## escrow

### Open a private message for compliance

Reads one private message of a person with a company-managed key, for a legal or compliance request. Needs a reason and a second admin’s approval, and is logged.

- **id:** `escrow.decrypt-dm` · **CLI:** `beamhop escrow decrypt-dm` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `compliance.write`
- changes settings/data · needs a second approver when approvals are on
- *Technical:* NIP-17 escrow: unwrap gift wrap 1059 → seal 13 → rumor 14/15 with the recipient’s managed key. Never possible for self-custody keys.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `eventId` | string |  |  |
| `reason` | string |  |  |
| `approvalId` | string |  |  |

### Launch kit

## plugins

### Browse plugins

See plugins you can add to your relay, and which ones you already have.

- **id:** `plugins.catalog` · **CLI:** `beamhop plugins catalog` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* Built-in catalog merged with the signed remote catalog (kind 30078, NIP-78).

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refresh` | boolean | `false` |  |

### Change plugin settings

Adjust how a plugin behaves.

- **id:** `plugins.configure` · **CLI:** `beamhop plugins configure` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `plugins.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Merges into config.plugins[id].config; `run` settings go to modules.plugins.entries[id] (sandbox, fail mode, budget).

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  |  |
| `config` | map |  | Settings to change |
| `replace` | boolean | `false` | Replace all settings instead of merging |
| `run` | section |  | How Beamhop runs the plugin |
| `run.source` | string |  | Where the plugin code comes from. Leave empty for built-in and catalog plugins. *Technical:* npm package name, file:/abs/path.ts or a path. Default: built-in, then the installed record, then beamhop-plugin-<id> in the plugins directory. |
| `run.trusted` | boolean |  | Run the plugin without safety limits for full speed. Only for code you fully trust; built-in plugins always are. *Technical:* In-process, no worker sandbox and no time budget. |
| `run.failMode` | `open` \| `closed` | `"open"` | What happens when the plugin breaks or is too slow. Block posts only if the plugin is a safety check you cannot do without. |
| `run.timeBudgetMs` | number |  | How long the plugin may take per post, in milliseconds. Empty = the default for all plugins. |
| `run.maxMemoryMb` | number |  | Memory limit for the plugin, in megabytes (best effort). |
| `run.priority` | number |  | Order among plugins: lower numbers run first. Empty = the plugin's own choice. *Technical:* Policy pipeline priority, ascending; clamped to 300+ so plugins run after built-in rules. |
| `run.approvedPermissions` | list of `read-events` \| `write-events` \| `network` \| `docs` |  | What you allowed this plugin to do. A plugin that asks for more is not started. |

### Turn a plugin off

Stop using a plugin without removing it.

- **id:** `plugins.disable` · **CLI:** `beamhop plugins disable` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `plugins.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* config.plugins[id].enabled = false

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | Plugin id, e.g. keyword-filter |

### Turn a plugin on

Start using a plugin you have added.

- **id:** `plugins.enable` · **CLI:** `beamhop plugins enable` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `plugins.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* config.plugins[id].enabled = true; clears the circuit breaker

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | Plugin id, e.g. keyword-filter |

### Add a plugin

Add a plugin from the catalog. You will see what it is allowed to do first.

- **id:** `plugins.install` · **CLI:** `beamhop plugins install` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `plugins.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Downloads the pinned version, verifies its integrity hash, installs into <dataDir>/plugins and adds it to config.plugins.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | Plugin id from the catalog |
| `enable` | boolean | `true` | Turn it on right away |
| `config` | map |  | Plugin settings |

### Plugin health

See how each plugin is doing: how often it runs, what it blocks, and how fast it is.

- **id:** `plugins.status` · **CLI:** `beamhop plugins status` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* Per plugin: calls, rejections, errors, timeouts, p95/avg hook latency (ms), mode.

### Remove a plugin

Turn a plugin off and delete it from this server.

- **id:** `plugins.uninstall` · **CLI:** `beamhop plugins uninstall` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `plugins.write`
- changes settings/data
- *Technical:* Removes config.plugins[id] and modules.plugins.entries[id], deletes installed files and the install record.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | Plugin id, e.g. keyword-filter |

## policy

### Why these limits?

Shows every limit, where it comes from, and what it means.

- **id:** `policy.explain-limits` · **CLI:** `beamhop policy explain-limits` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* explainLimits(relay, tier): goals → media settings → tier → overrides.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tier` | string |  |  |
| `goals` | section |  | What-if: preview the limits these goal values would give (nothing is saved) |
| `goals.openness` | number | `70` | How open the relay is: 0 = very strict, 100 = anyone can post. Move it down if strangers cause trouble. |
| `goals.spamTolerance` | number | `40` | 0 = aggressive spam blocking, 100 = relaxed. Lower it during a spam wave; raise it if real posts get blocked. |
| `goals.storage` | number | `60` | 0 = keep it lean (short retention), 100 = keep everything. Lower it when the disk fills up. |
| `goals.media` | number | `50` | 0 = basic media, 100 = rich media (resizing, video). Higher uses more disk and processing. |
| `goals.speedVsCost` | number | `50` | 0 = cheapest to run, 100 = fastest. Raise it if the relay feels slow and you can afford more resources. |
| `persona` | `public-social` \| `private-team` \| `wot-community` \| `media-host` \| `organization` |  | What-if: preview the limits of this relay type (applied before `goals`) |

### Filter activity

How many posts each filter blocked, muted or held.

- **id:** `policy.stats` · **CLI:** `beamhop policy stats` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `insights.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* In-memory counters per PolicyHook id since process start.

## portal

### Delete everything a person stored

Permanently removes all posts and files of one person from this relay and refuses them in the future.

- **id:** `portal.right-to-vanish` · **CLI:** `beamhop portal right-to-vanish` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `users.write`
- changes settings/data · needs a second approver when approvals are on
- *Technical:* NIP-62 right to vanish: EventStore.vanish(pubkey, until) + removal of owned blobs.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `relayId` | string |  |  |
| `pubkey` | string |  |  |
| `until` | number |  |  |

## retention

### Clean up old posts now

Remove posts that are older than your keep-for rules right away.

- **id:** `retention.run-now` · **CLI:** `beamhop retention run-now` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `config.write`
- changes settings/data
- *Technical:* Chunked sweep: per-kind rules, then tier retentionDays / relay-wide rule / goals defaultRetentionDays on regular kinds; legal holds respected.

## status

### Post an incident

Tell users on the status page that something is wrong.

- **id:** `status.open-incident` · **CLI:** `beamhop status open-incident` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `moderation.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Creates a public.incidents document shown on /status of this relay.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `relayId` | string |  |  |
| `title` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `impact` | `minor` \| `major` \| `outage` | `"minor"` |  |
| `state` | `investigating` \| `identified` \| `monitoring` | `"investigating"` |  |

### Resolve an incident

Mark an incident as fixed on the status page.

- **id:** `status.resolve-incident` · **CLI:** `beamhop status resolve-incident` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `moderation.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Sets state=resolved on a public.incidents document.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `relayId` | string |  |  |
| `id` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string | `"This incident has been resolved."` |  |

### Update an incident

Post progress on an incident shown on the status page.

- **id:** `status.update-incident` · **CLI:** `beamhop status update-incident` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `moderation.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Appends an update to a public.incidents document.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `relayId` | string |  |  |
| `id` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `state` | `investigating` \| `identified` \| `monitoring` |  |  |
| `impact` | `minor` \| `major` \| `outage` |  |  |
| `title` | string |  |  |

## tokens

### Create an API token

A key for scripts and automation. It can only do what you allow, and it expires.

- **id:** `tokens.create` · **CLI:** `beamhop tokens create` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Bearer token bh_<id>_<secret>; secret stored as SHA-256; scopes intersect with the creator’s current roles.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string |  | What it is for |
| `scopes` | list of `relay.read` \| `insights.read` \| `moderation.write` \| `media.write` \| `users.write` \| `config.write` \| `plugins.write` \| `admins.manage` \| `node.manage` \| `compliance.read` \| `compliance.write` |  | What it may do (default: everything you can do) |
| `expiresInDays` | number | `90` | Days until it stops working |

### Show API tokens

Your API tokens (owners see everyone’s).

- **id:** `tokens.list` · **CLI:** `beamhop tokens list` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* Token metadata only (id, name, scopes, createdAt, expiresAt, lastUsedAt); secrets are never returned.

### Revoke an API token

The token stops working immediately.

- **id:** `tokens.revoke` · **CLI:** `beamhop tokens revoke` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- changes settings/data · undoable

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  | Token id |

## users

### People

Everyone seen here recently, with their tier, activity, storage and status.

- **id:** `users.list` · **CLI:** `beamhop users list` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* Union of policy state (first-seen, last activity, tiers, bans, mutes, allowlist) and blob owners (BlobIndex); sorted by last activity; offset cursor. Activity is recorded at most every 15 minutes per pubkey. quotaBytes = docs blossom.quotas override ?? kernel.limits(relay, tier).defaultBlobQuotaBytes (tier.blobQuotaBytes → blossom.defaultQuotaBytes → goals).

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | number | `50` | How many to show |
| `cursor` | string |  | Paging cursor from the previous page |
| `search` | string |  | Part of a public key (hex) or a full npub |
| `status` | `all` \| `banned` \| `muted` \| `allowlisted` \| `active` | `"all"` | Only show people in this state |
| `activeWithinDays` | number |  | Only people active in the last N days |

### Change plan

Move a person to another tier (limits bundle).

- **id:** `users.set-tier` · **CLI:** `beamhop users set-tier` · **scope:** relay · **permission:** `users.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Explicit tier assignment in policy.tiers; overrides tier rules. null = back to rules/default.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pubkey` | string |  |  |
| `tier` | string |  |  |

## webhooks

### Add a webhook

Send a signed notification to another service when something happens.

- **id:** `webhooks.add` · **CLI:** `beamhop webhooks add` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `plugins.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* POST JSON, HMAC-SHA256 in X-Beamhop-Signature over "<timestamp>.<body>", retries with backoff.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string |  | Where to send notifications |
| `events` | list of `conn.open` \| `conn.close` \| `event.accepted` \| `event.rejected` \| `event.held` \| `event.deleted` \| `req.served` \| `auth.success` \| `report.received` \| `blob.uploaded` \| `blob.deleted` \| `blob.quarantined` \| `admin.action` \| `config.changed` \| `error` | `[]` | What to send |
| `filter` | section |  | Also send new posts matching this filter |
| `filter.kinds` | list of number |  | Only send posts of these types. Empty = all types. *Technical:* Event kinds to match. |
| `filter.authors` | list of string |  | Only send posts by these people. Empty = everyone. *Technical:* Hex pubkeys of event authors to match. |
| `filter.relays` | list of string |  | Only send posts accepted on these relays (their internal ids). Empty = all relays. |
| `secret` | string |  | Shared secret (created for you if empty) |
| `description` | string |  |  |

### Webhooks

See where Beamhop sends notifications and how deliveries are going.

- **id:** `webhooks.list` · **CLI:** `beamhop webhooks list` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `relay.read`
- read-only
- *Technical:* modules.webhooks.hooks with per-hook delivery stats; secrets are hidden.

### Remove a webhook

Stop sending notifications to a service.

- **id:** `webhooks.remove` · **CLI:** `beamhop webhooks remove` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `plugins.write`
- changes settings/data · undoable
- *Technical:* Removes modules.webhooks.hooks[id]; queued retries are dropped.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  |  |

### Send a test notification

Send a test message now to check that the other service receives it.

- **id:** `webhooks.test` · **CLI:** `beamhop webhooks test` · **scope:** node · **permission:** `plugins.write`
- changes settings/data
- *Technical:* Single signed POST of type "ping"; no retries.

| Setting | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string |  |  |
